The `run-due-checks` schedule runs every minute with concurrency limit 8, records each check and updates `last_checked_at`; one monitor failure is logged without stopping the sweep. The `prune-checks` schedule runs daily at 04:13 and uses the configured retention period. Mutations and sweeps that run checks publish `uptime:changed`.
